decision.decidedBy: NF-114 technical assessment for the single maintainer
decision.rationale: All five 0.6 release-plan criteria are covered by the bounded offline fixture. The recorded revision qualifies for a source-only milestone, subject to separate maintainer publication authority and exact-cut checks.

documentation.summary: The qualified fixture, its setup, audit behavior and limitations are documented.

schemas.summary: The candidate keeps the preview schema and manifest dialect. Repository schema CI passed.

examples.summary: The maintained example set passes repository validation. The synthetic fixture uses four valid manifest types.

validation.summary: All 76 fixture cases agree across three native platforms, including 66 retained baseline cases.

rfc-governance.summary: The host follows Accepted RFC-0025 layout B. The existing review governance CI passed.

compatibility-migrations.summary: Static CLI and validator are unchanged from the published alpha. The experimental host binds the exact API and schema pair. No manifest migration is needed.

security-limitations.summary: The fixture blocks external effects and keeps redacted in-memory receipts. Current validation lock audit has zero matches, and known root maintenance findings remain disclosed.

evidence.description: Separate lockfile inventory, audit receipt and retained findings

release-evidence.summary: Exact-source CI, native fixture reports and fresh source-archive setup support the technical review. Public 0.6 bytes are pending publication.

evidence.description: Source, reports, clean setup and dependency evidence

limitations: Source-only prototype with one synthetic, explicit offline read.
No live provider, credential or filesystem access, deployment or autonomous destructive action.
No durable audit, recovery, cross-restart replay prevention or OS isolation claim.
No native installer, project publisher signature, NF-RUNTIME or NF-CLI conformance claim.
The unchanged root maintenance graph retains four fast-uri advisories affecting one dependency.
Publication authority and verification from public 0.6 archives are separate and pending.
